subject: Using GGIR with GENEActiv hip data among infants

messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Using GGIR with GENEActiv hip data among infants
parts:
Hi Vincent et al.,

Thank you for much for creating and maintaining the GGIR package for accelerometer data analysis. One of my colleagues is currently collecting 24-hour data using GENEActiv at hip position among infants and she'd like to know if it is possible for her to run GGIR as well with her dataset? We know that the sleep algorithm was developed based on wrist-acceleration (i.e. changes in arm degree); therefore it might not be suitable for analysis of hip dataset? Is there a way for her to analyse the sleep data using this package as well?

Thanks.

Best regards,
John.

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Using GGIR with GENEActiv hip data among infants
parts:
Hi John,
Technically speaking it is possible to use GGIR for any accelerometer collected on any location.
Based on the design of the sleep detection algorithm I expect that it could still provide a reasonable estimate, but to my knowledge no research has been conducted yet to confirm that.
Best, Vincent
